card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits, decimal points or slashes in the middle of a number, usually a dose, weight or rate, where the number is not finished yet.

modes.label: Decimal point in a dose
modes.description: The point or digit right after the whole part of a decimal dose or weight band.

modes.label: Later digit of a long number
modes.description: A digit partway through a multi-digit dose such as 200 or 662, with more digits to come.
modes.example: recommended maintenance dosage of 20<<0>> mg once daily

modes.label: Fraction slash
modes.description: The slash in a fractional tablet dose.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a dose number, before the number and its unit are complete.
